name: Files
author: Carmine Paolino
description: Find files and folders as you type, with previews for code in your configured Neovim theme, PDF pages, images, documents, archives, audio and video frames. Browse folders, type / or ~/ to browse any path, and act on results. Run omarchy-shell shell toggle crmne.files, or set a shortcut in Files settings, which also configures search folders, exclusions and previews. Applying a shortcut writes a dedicated Hyprland file loaded from bindings.lua; installation does not change your bindings.
